facts.title: apple and cheddar crisp salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon (15 grams) mayonnaise or Greek-style plain yogurt
Salt and freshly ground black pepper
1 cup (115 grams or 4 ounces) sharp cheddar, coarsely grated
5 ounces (140 grams) kale leaves, any variety, cut into thin ribbons [see Note]
1 large crisp apple, halved, cored, and cut thin
facts.yield_text: 2 giant servings or 4 with a meal
facts.author: Deb Perelman
